title: Enforcement contract vector v1
description: An ordered list of HTTP steps against the enforcement API and the outcome each must produce. The Go contract test executes every vector against the real handlers on a fresh FakeKernel; a vector or schema that looks wrong is a contract change, made in its own PR (medic convention).

kernel.description: Optional FakeKernel overrides for this vector (capability probes). A missing entry means the primitive is supported.

unsupported_kinds.description: Kinds whose capability probe reports unsupported.

auth.description: Defaults to true; a false step exercises the unauthenticated rejection path.

state.description: Expected response 'state' when the step succeeds.

error.description: Expected error code on an error reply.

evidence_echoes_action_id.description: Assert the reply's action_id equals the request's.
